title: Renames `billing` to `collection_method` on invoices, subscriptions, and subscription schedules
summary: Renames the billing attribute on invoices, subscriptions, and subscription schedules to collection_method.
migrationNotes: The terminology now better reflects the purpose of the attribute, which is to specify how the payment will be collected, rather than just the billing mechanism.

sources.quote: | [Renames `billing` to `collection_method` on invoices, subscriptions, and subscription schedules](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2019-10-17/renames-billing-attribute.md) | Billing, Invoicing | Breaking | api |
Renames the `billing` attribute on invoices, subscriptions, and subscription schedules to `collection_method`.
